evidence.quote: assuming that the dust is heated by star formation

fitting.value: Bayesian (MR-MOOSE); templates chosen as best fit to ALMA points

evidence.quote: As the SED templates have no free parameters, we chose the templates that fit our ALMA detections the best.

validation.value: Two approaches compared as lower and upper limits

evidence.quote: the results of these two approaches can be treated as lower and upper limits

analysis_steps.goal: Extract spectra and fit CO lines

method.value: Spectra extracted from cubes and fitted with Gaussians for widths and integrated fluxes

evidence.quote: We fitted the spectra using Gaussian line profiles in order to determine the line widths and velocity integrated fluxes of the sources.
when fitting a single Gaussian profile

method.value: Moment 1/2 maps, PV diagram at -30 deg, GalPak3D rotating disk model

evidence.quote: For the PV diagram we chose the angle towards the highest velocity gradient ($-30\ensuremath{^\circ}$)

key_parameters.value: Exponential disk, arctan rotation curve, default settings

evidence.quote: we use the default settings as the resolution of the data is insufficient to distinguish between different models
GalPak$^{\rm3D}$ is a Bayesian parametric tool to constrain galaxy parameters directly from three-dimensional data cubes

findings_qualitative.value: The QSO is bright in CO(5-4) and CO(8-7) despite low-J non-detections, so it hosts warm, highly excited gas.

evidence.quote: This indicates that the host galaxy of the quasar has a significant amount of warm, highly-excited molecular gas.

claims.experiment: CO(5-4) and CO(8-7) ALMA detections converted to gas mass
claims.finding: Quasar is not gas-poor; low-J non-detections reflect excitation

evidence.quote: it is clear that the quasar is not gas-poor as it was suggested by previous studies
only about $22-25\%$ of the total emission in both bands

claims.hypothesis: Broad CO lines of the companion arise from rotation
claims.finding: Signs of rotation, possibly beam smeared; no outflow

evidence.quote: in the absence of high resolution observations a proper analysis of the kinematics is not possible

claims.hypothesis: CO SLED excitation can be constrained

evidence.quote: the model cannot constrain well the excitation properties of the source

limitations_admitted.value: FIR SED poorly sampled so L_IR and SFR are lower limits; kinematics unresolved; SLED has too few points

evidence.quote: adequate observations around the peak of the FIR SED are lacking

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas mass of QSO relies on assumed thermalised CO(5-4) and alpha_CO=0.8
SED L_IR spans a wide range with few data points
